notes: One row per non-skipped merge_group workflow run, not per merged PR.
Rules are read from each run head. null trigger lists mean the historical dispatcher was unavailable; empty lists mean no trigger.
Trigger counts are inclusive and overlap. A global trigger also forces all Rust.
Observation requires a selector invocation followed by its selecting-the-workspace line, excluding tooling test fixtures. No observation does not prove that the workspace was not selected.
No historical CPU measurement is available.
